+

+    table.add_column("Col")
+    for row in rows:
+        table.add_row(row)
+    return table
+
+# 1. Initial render
+rows1 = ["Row 1", "Row 2", "Row 3", "Row 4"]

+
+# 3. Final render

+

+    time.sleep(0.1)
